title: DurableEventManifest
description: Manifest of events that survive restarts. Adds replay, ordering and retention guarantees on top of the in-memory event manifest.

schema.description: Schema file that validates this event, e.g. session-event.json.

replay.description: True when consumers receive the event after reconnecting.

ordering.description: Scope in which seq must be strictly increasing.

retention_days.description: Days the event is kept before compaction. 0 keeps it until compaction.

requires_checkpoint.description: True when replay needs a consumer checkpoint.

events.description: One entry per durable event type.
